frozen_on: 2026-11-17, before any test-split metric was computed

data.source: clinical-llm-eval (Hariprasad 2026, arXiv:2603.00917): public raw PubMedQA outputs of 5 open models under 5 prompt styles
data.generation_settings_as_reported: Ollama, temperature 0, max 10 output tokens, one run per prompt
data.task: PubMedQA: fixed abstract evidence + research question -> conclusion yes / no / maybe (supports / contradicts / insufficient)

split.use: dev items: inspect raw outputs and write the E3 parser rules; test items (150): all reported results

distance.D_cat: 0 if same category else 1 (INVALID counts as its own category)
distance.D_ord: yes-no = 1, yes-maybe = no-maybe = 0.5, same = 0; INVALID vs anything = 1

primary_metric: S_p (review Eq. 7) with D_cat and the majority category as C-bar, per model on test items; equivalently mean share of styles agreeing with the item's majority conclusion
secondary_metrics: share of fully stable items (all 5 styles agree)
polarity reversal rate (item gets both yes and no)
uncertainty-shift rate (maybe plus a definite answer, no reversal)
Errica et al. sensitivity (normalised entropy) and consistency (1 - mean TVD within gold class)
CSI-style component ranking under random weights (review Eq. 8)
evaluator_comparison: same outputs scored by E1/E2/E3; report how S_p, reversal rate and accuracy change; human labels on a seeded sample are left to the author

uncertainty.bootstrap: items resampled, 10000 resamples, seed 2026, percentile 95% CI

expectations_stated_before_test.H1: for every model, at least one test item changes conclusion category across styles (review Sec. 2.2, 5)
expectations_stated_before_test.H2: E2 substring scoring changes measured S_p or reversal rate relative to E3 for at least one model by >= 0.02 (Hua et al. evaluation artifact, review Sec. 7.3)
expectations_stated_before_test.H3: accuracy and stability are not the same ranking (review Table 4)
